articles.text:
THE POPULAR new class of weight-loss drugs that has reshaped obesity treatment - especially inthe United States and Europe - isnow makingits way to India.

US-based pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly announced the launch of Tirzepatide, marketed as Mounjaro, in India on Thursday. The medication comes in a single-dose vial and is designed to be self-administered as a weekly injection. In India, it will be available on prescription, with a 2.5 mg vial priced at Rs 3,500 anda 5 mgvial atRs4,375. Depending on the prescribed dosage, patients would spend at least Rs 14,000 per month. "Mounjaro (tirzepatide) will be available, upon obtaining a valid prescription, in registered pharmacies in the coming weeks," the company said. Tirzepatide is part of anew group of medicines called incretinmimetics, which work by imitating natural guthormones.
